note: Single sentences on which the steering directions are estimated. None of them is in an evaluation set.
texts: The bakery on the corner opens before dawn.
My cousin repaired the fence behind the barn.
The lecture hall was empty by late afternoon.
A narrow bridge crosses the river near the mill.
The mechanic checked the engine and the brakes.
Our neighbours planted roses along the garden wall.
The library keeps old maps in a locked cabinet.
She carried the groceries up three flights of stairs.
The fishermen mended their nets on the pier.
A small plane landed on the frozen lake.
The students waited outside for the morning bus.
He folded the letter and put it away.
The road to the village winds through the hills.
The cook tasted the soup and added more salt.
A grey cat slept on the warm windowsill.
The clerk stamped the forms and returned them.
The orchestra tuned their instruments before the concert.
We painted the kitchen walls a pale green.
The postman left a parcel by the back door.
The children built a tall tower from wooden blocks.
A steady wind blew across the open field.
The guide led the hikers along the ridge.
The shop assistant wrapped the vase in thick paper.
They watched the harbour lights from the balcony.
